changes.summary: Area-based project activities may occur on existing forest cover where the area has not been managed for wood products in the previous ten years.
The census-based approach is clarified for projects that do not cause land-use change, with a maximum density of 50 planting units per hectare and proportional treatment of project instances.
Remote sensing may be used to estimate qualifying pre-existing woody biomass at the project start date under specified conditions.
Census-based projects may identify planting units using qualifying GPS coordinates or durable physical markers with unique identifiers.
Area-based projects may remove pre-existing woody biomass offsite where it is measured and fully accounted for as project emissions.
Verra revised wording throughout the methodology for clarity, consistency, and ease of interpretation.
The area-based approach explicitly requires VMD0054 for leakage quantification.
